# Spec: Cache a value

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/cache-a-value.md)

**Start:** `/data/cache`  
**Persona:** A developer adding caching to a service  
**Goal:** Store text under a key, read it back, and remove it.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Store a value | A confirmation names the key. |
| 2 | Look it up | The stored text is shown.<br>The provider name is shown. |
